Question Choices: A box plot shows a vertical line inside the box at 28. What does this line represent?
Hints: The middle value of the data
Solution: The line inside the box is the median

Question Choices: A box plot has Q1 = 25 and Q3 = 32. Select. What percentage of data is between 25 and 32?: 7% 25% 50% 100%
Hints: The box represents the middle half of the data
Solution: Q1 to Q3 covers 50% of the data

Question Choices: A box plot shows: Min = 4, Q1 = 8, Median = 12, Q3 = 18, Max = 35. Which is TRUE?   (A) 75% of data is below 18   (B) 50% of data is between 8 and 18   (C) All data is below 12   (D) Median = average of all values
Hints: Think about what each part of the box plot shows
Solution: The box from Q1 (8) to Q3 (18) holds the middle 50% of the data

Question Choices: A box plot shows all values within the whiskers and no separate dots. Is there an outlier? Answer yes or no.
Hints: Look for dots outside the whiskers
Solution: All values within whiskers -> no outlier shown
